sentence: This project uses computer analyses to study how the risk for cardiometabolic diseases differs between men and women.
This project plans and tests auricular point acupressure that people use themselves to manage chronic pain in rural populations.
This project studies how stromal cells in the tumor microenvironment hold back aggressive prostate cancer.
This project tries to find out how microtubules, which are protein polymers inside cells, are built and rearranged.
This project studies whether demographic, clinical and genetic risk factors can identify Veterans at high risk of suicidal behavior.
This project builds an imaging platform that maps ovarian metastases and treats them with a targeted drug and light.
This project tries to find biomarkers that predict early emphysema and tell apart its different patterns of lung damage.
This project builds a tool that uses computer vision and engineering analysis to help diagnose pediatric subglottic stenosis.
This project uses deep learning to remove motion artifacts caused by cardiopulmonary resuscitation so shock decisions can be made without stopping it.
This project tests whether vitamin D supplementation helps patients with colorectal cancer survive longer and how it affects the tumor microenvironment.
This project studies the role of thin-stranded pericytes in neurovascular coupling, which links brain cell activity to the delivery of nutrients.
This project studies how vascular and demographic risk factors and brain changes after an ischemic stroke lead to cognitive impairments and dementia.
This project builds radionuclide imaging probes that target the kidney to assess kidney function in disease with little invasion.
This project studies how a regulator of mitochondrial metabolism and cell differentiation affects the spread of breast cancer.
This project studies how a neurotoxin called beta-methylamino-L-alanine affects human cell lines and tests aptamers designed to block it.
This project sets up a system that makes and measures ultrafine particles for an inhalation exposure facility.
This project studies how a protein controls activation in a cell signaling cascade and its roles in mouse development and cancer.
This project tries to find out which factors and tumor features are linked to pancreatic cancer in younger people.
This project uses spatial omics profiling of human pancreatic tissue to find molecular pathways in early type 1 diabetes.
